tagline: 佳能取景器相机，1985 年发布
description: 佳能于1985年推出的取景器相机。配备35mm, f/4.5 (3 elements in 3 groups).。

specs.英文简介: The Canon Snappy S (Snappy S-30 FF in Europe) of July 1985 is a compact camera for budget-conscious photographers, and was the third member of the Canon Snappy series.
